 Order

 Crl.M.(Bail)889/2022
1.
The appellant was convicted for the offence under Section 376(2)(n) IPC and sentenced to RI for ten years with fine of Rs.10,000/-.
As per the nominal roll dated 29.08.2022 the appellant has already undergone 6 years and 9 months approximately and till date, he has undergone more than seven years in custody.
Hence, the appellant suffered more than  of the total sentence and appeal will take time to come on board for hearing.

2. In the circumstances, the sentence of appellant stand suspended during the pendency of appeal and he is granted bail on his executing a personal bond of Rs.10,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court /Duty MM.
The fine amount be deposited prior to release of appellant.
The appellant is also directed to provide his contact number/address to the SHO concerned as also he shall keep open his location application in his mobile at all time.
The appellant shall not threaten or coerce the victim in any manner, lest it shall be a ground for cancellation of his bail and shall not visit the locality of the prosecutrix.
3. The application stands disposed of in above terms.
